name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: GETCERTS-PLUS-LOGOUT CONTROL BUILD, not for production: calls nsIX509CertDB.getCerts() then nsIPK11Token.logoutAndDropAuthenticatedResources() on our token, 10 seconds after startup. Tests whether that recovers/avoids the reading breakage getCerts() alone caused in 0.4.10.
